claims.claim: Used Qasa rechargeable fan for sale.
claims.evidence: Witness report identifies a standing fan with grille/blades and a logo mark on the hub, but the brand/model is not readable and no rechargeable/battery feature is shown.

claims.claim: Lasts up to 2 hours when fully charged and longer when on low.
claims.evidence: No runtime/charging test, battery indicator, charger, or battery compartment is shown in the witness photos.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: Photos show the fan externally, but do not clearly show age indicators, wear level, or proof of purchase date.

claims.claim: No fault at all; the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: No working test, sound/vibration check, or internal inspection evidence is shown.
No receipt/warranty card is shown in the witness report.

risks.risk: Not actually rechargeable (could be mains-only), which changes value and buyer expectations.
risks.proof: A photo/clip showing the charger, charging port/battery compartment, or the label/spec sheet indicating rechargeable/battery capacity.
risks.if_unproven: Price as a standard used standing fan (not rechargeable), assuming mains operation only.

risks.risk: Motor may be weak or noisy even if it looks intact; speed control may not work.
risks.proof: A short video of the fan running through all speed settings (and showing stable airflow and normal motor sound).
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully tested/possibly needing service, with worst-case performance.

risks.risk: Blade damage or imbalance (cracks/bends) causing wobble/vibration.
risks.proof: A clip showing the blades spinning at high speed with no wobble and no visible vibration.
risks.if_unproven: Price as potentially unbalanced/needs blade check.

risks.risk: Oscillation/tilt function may be missing, weak, or not holding position (head is tilted in photos).
risks.proof: A video showing oscillation/tilt operation and that it holds position correctly.

risks.risk: Electrical/cable/plug issues (loose plug, frayed cable, intermittent power).
risks.proof: Close-up photos of plug and cable condition plus a clip showing steady operation without flicker or cut-outs.
risks.if_unproven: Price as electrical condition unknown; assume possible cable/plug replacement.

risks.risk: Missing parts or unstable base/stand hardware affecting safety and usability.
risks.proof: Photos of the full base/stand from multiple angles showing all screws/covers and stability test (gentle push test).

risks.risk: Size/wattage/spec not captured; value depends heavily on fan diameter and power rating.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/spec label (wattage, model, diameter/size, speed modes).
risks.if_unproven: Price at the lowest likely spec for a standing fan of this appearance.

risks.risk: Cosmetic wear not fully captured (rust, dents, grille damage, repainting) could reduce resale value.
risks.proof: Full-detail photos of grille, blades, head housing, and base showing any dents/rust/scratches.

proof_requests: Clear photo of the brand/model label and rating plate (wattage, diameter/size, speed modes).
If rechargeable: photo of the battery/charging port plus the charger and a runtime test video (showing charge level and time).
Video of the fan running on all speed settings (low/medium/high) showing normal motor sound and airflow.
Video showing blade spin at high speed with no wobble/vibration.
Video demonstrating oscillation/tilt (if it oscillates) and that it holds position correctly.
Close-up photos of plug and entire power cable (no fraying/loose connections).
Photos of the full base/stand hardware (all screws/covers) and a stability test.
response.reason: The witness clearly identifies a standing fan with visible grille/blades and basic external condition, so it can be priced at a worst-case used level. Rechargeable claims, runtime, and working condition are not verifiable from the provided report, so the price should assume the least favorable scenario until tested.
